Name: labSeedTag
Title: Lab Seed Tag
Description: Marks the object as created by OktaTestEnvironment. Teardown keys off this value, so do not edit it by hand.

Name: labBadgeId
Title: Lab Badge ID
Description: Physical badge identifier. A short bounded string, so length validation actually fires.

Name: labClearanceLevel
Title: Lab Clearance Level
Description: Enumerated clearance band. Exercises enum and oneOf handling in exports and group rules.

Name: labIsContractor
Title: Lab Is Contractor
Description: Boolean flag. Exercises the non-string branch of anything that stringifies a profile.

Name: labRiskScore
Title: Lab Risk Score
Description: Integer risk score from 0 to 100. Exercises numeric typing, including the value zero.

Name: labContractEndDate
Title: Lab Contract End Date
Description: ISO 8601 date held as a string, which is how Okta actually stores dates. Empty for permanent staff.

Name: labEntitlements
Title: Lab Entitlements
Description: Multi-valued entitlement list. Exercises array handling, which is where flat CSV exports usually break.

Name: labCostCenterOwner
Title: Lab Cost Center Owner
Description: Display name of the person who owns this user's cost center. Deliberately a name, not an ID, so resolution has to happen.

Name: labAgencyName
Title: Lab Agency Name
Description: Staffing agency the contractor came through. Exists only on the Contractor user type.

Name: labPurchaseOrder
Title: Lab Purchase Order
Description: PO number the contractor is billed against. Only on the Contractor type, so a default-schema export cannot see it.
